subject: Great House Farm, Llandough — HMLR ref N610CGV — follow-up on Ministry of Justice reply and casework log
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear Mr Doughty,

Great House Farm, Llandough — HM Land Registry ref N610CGV — follow-up

Thank you for your office's forwarding on 18 September of the letter from HM Land Registry's Chief Executive and Chief Land Registrar. I understand your office is still waiting for a reply from the Ministry of Justice.

Could your office please:

1. tell me whether the Ministry of Justice has replied, and if not, when your office last chased it;
2. confirm that my emails of 27 and 28 September 2026 have been received and logged as casework, since earlier messages were reported as not found; and
3. let me have a caseworker's name and a direct reply address, so that I do not have to rely on the general inbox.

For your information, the Independent Complaints Reviewer has opened an investigation (ICR/090/26), the Wales Office internal review of 26FOI 103 is due by 26 October 2026, and HM Land Registry's subject access reply is due by 28 October 2026. I am not asking you to intervene in any of those processes, only to press the Ministry of Justice for the reply your office is waiting on.

Regards,

Requester
